background_story: Aden was a brilliant and ambitious young journalist, often drawing inspiration from the infamous Dreyfus Affair. He saw parallels between the wrongful conviction of Alfred Dreyfus and the modern-day injustices he sought to expose. Aden's investigative reporting style was meticulous and relentless, earning him both accolades and enemies. His most notable case involved uncovering a deep-seated corruption within the city's government, which led to the resignation of several high-ranking officials. Like Émile Zola, who famously defended Dreyfus, Aden used his platform to speak truth to power and fight for the marginalized. His fearless reporting earned him the nickname 'The Modern-Day Zola' among his peers, and his name became synonymous with journalistic integrity.
